CG-002.mechanism: Fetchers that do not execute JavaScript receive HTML without the detected fact types.
CG-002.why_it_matters: An assistant cannot confirm or quote facts that are absent from the initial response.
fix_template: Emit {facts} in server-rendered HTML at {url}
Add matching JSON-LD fields for {facts} on {url}

CG-003.mechanism: Invalid structured data prevents parsers from using the intended entity fields.
CG-003.why_it_matters: Search and assistant systems may ignore malformed or incomplete markup.
fix_template: Repair the invalid schema.org properties at {url}
Validate the JSON-LD fields against the selected schema type

EF-001.mechanism: A missing concise description leaves the site identity dependent on inference.
EF-001.why_it_matters: Assistants need a direct statement to describe the brand accurately.
fix_template: Add a plain-language value proposition to {url}
Add the same description to Organization JSON-LD

EF-002.mechanism: Ambiguous identity signals make it hard to distinguish this entity from similarly named ones.
EF-002.why_it_matters: An assistant can attach facts to the wrong organization.
fix_template: Add a distinguishing qualifier on {url}
Link authoritative profiles with sameAs in structured data

EF-005.mechanism: Answer elements split across pages force systems to assemble an incomplete answer.
EF-005.why_it_matters: No page can be cited as a complete answer to the detected intent.
fix_template: Create one canonical answer page for the detected intent
Link that page from the relevant source pages including {url}

EF-007.mechanism: Without entity schema, machines must infer the primary entity from prose alone.
EF-007.why_it_matters: Identity and service facts are less reliably extracted.
fix_template: Add Organization or Service JSON-LD on {url}
Validate required name and description fields

EG-001.mechanism: The first-view proxy lacks both a clear offer and an observable next step.
EG-001.why_it_matters: Visitors may not understand what to do next.
fix_template: State the offer in the opening content at {url}
Place one verb-led CTA in the first viewport

EG-002.mechanism: An unordered heading outline weakens document structure.
EG-002.why_it_matters: Screen readers and extractors lose section hierarchy.
fix_template: Use one H1 at {url}
Order subsequent headings without skipped levels

EG-003.mechanism: Title, H1, and opening paragraph describe different vocabulary.
EG-003.why_it_matters: Users and machines receive inconsistent page framing.
fix_template: Align the title and H1 vocabulary at {url}
Rewrite the first paragraph to name the same offer

EG-004.mechanism: The compact first-view proxy found no verb-led next step.
EG-004.why_it_matters: A visitor may not discover the intended action quickly.
fix_template: Add a verb-led CTA near the opening content at {url}
Use descriptive CTA text that names the next action

EG-005.mechanism: Computed foreground/background colors fail the contrast proxy.
EG-005.why_it_matters: Low contrast can make an action hard to perceive.
fix_template: Adjust the measured CTA colors at {url}
Recheck the foreground/background contrast ratio

EG-006.mechanism: Pages in the sitemap are not represented in sampled navigation.
EG-006.why_it_matters: Visitors and crawlers may have no ordinary path to important pages.
fix_template: Link the missing intent page from semantic navigation
Verify navigation coverage for {url}

EG-007.mechanism: An intent-bearing page has no sampled internal onward path.
EG-007.why_it_matters: A visitor can reach a dead end instead of a next step.
fix_template: Add a relevant onward link on {url}
Verify the target exists in the sampled site

EG-008.mechanism: Key facts are hidden in the captured initial page state.
EG-008.why_it_matters: Visitors and non-rendering extractors may not see the facts.
fix_template: Make the detected facts visible in initial HTML at {url}
Keep the visible facts consistent with structured data

EG-009.mechanism: A very long unbroken paragraph reduces scannability.
EG-009.why_it_matters: Readers can miss the important action or fact.
fix_template: Split the long paragraph at {url} into labelled sections
Move the key action or fact into a concise lead sentence

EG-010.mechanism: Controls lack an associated label or autofill signal.
EG-010.why_it_matters: Form purpose can be unclear to assistive technology and users.
fix_template: Associate each control with a label at {url}
Add appropriate autocomplete or aria-label fields

EG-011.mechanism: Measured inline CTA dimensions are smaller than the tap-target proxy.
EG-011.why_it_matters: Small targets are harder to activate on touch devices.
fix_template: Increase the measured CTA dimensions on {url} to at least 44px
Recheck width and height in the rendered style

EG-012.mechanism: Declared language or supplied hreflang values are invalid.
EG-012.why_it_matters: Language-aware systems may misclassify the page locale.
fix_template: Set a valid html lang attribute at {url}
Correct each existing hreflang value to a BCP-47 language tag

EG-013.mechanism: The static first-paint proxy exceeds the documented weight or blocking-script threshold.
EG-013.why_it_matters: Heavy initial resources can delay meaningful content.
fix_template: Defer non-critical scripts at {url}
Reduce initial HTML or stylesheet payload identified by the page-weight proxy

TF-001.mechanism: The same canonical fact has conflicting values across sampled pages.
TF-001.why_it_matters: Assistants cannot safely quote a single value.
fix_template: Choose one authoritative value and update every cited URL
Add a canonical facts source linked from {url}

TF-002.why_it_matters: Visitors may question whether the site is current.
fix_template: Update the copyright year at {url}
Clarify the date context of the newer content

TF-003.mechanism: A material fact appears on only one sampled page.
TF-003.why_it_matters: A single page failure can remove the only confirmable source.
fix_template: Link a canonical facts page from {url}
Reference the same fact from one additional relevant page

TF-004.mechanism: A numeric claim is not accompanied by a stated source or method.
TF-004.why_it_matters: Readers cannot judge whether the claim remains trustworthy.
fix_template: Add a first-party source beside the numeric claim at {url}
Include a date or methodology field for the claim

TF-006.mechanism: A price is shown without an effective-date signal.
TF-006.why_it_matters: Price information can become stale without context.
fix_template: Add an effective or updated date near pricing at {url}
Link to the current pricing terms

TF-007.mechanism: A sampled internal link resolves to no captured target.
TF-007.why_it_matters: Crawlers and visitors cannot follow the advertised route.
fix_template: Repair the internal link at {url}
Verify the linked target returns a readable page

TF-008.mechanism: A contact route has no available sampled destination.
TF-008.why_it_matters: People and assistants cannot reach a visible contact channel.
fix_template: Repair the contact destination from {url}
Keep a visible alternate contact method on the source page
